senses.en: Able to operate or make decisions without being controlled by another organization.
senses.example: Our team hired an independent testing company to check the quality of the fabric.

senses.en: Work done by people, especially the work needed to produce goods or provide a service.
senses.example: The repair estimate includes two hours of labor and the cost of a new belt.

senses.en: The possibility that someone or something can develop or succeed in the future.
senses.example: The online store has the potential to reach customers outside the city.

senses.en: A person or organization that works with another on a shared activity or goal.
senses.example: We chose a local partner to handle repairs while our own team sets up the service center.

senses.en: Having the training, skills, or credentials needed to do a particular job.
senses.example: Only a qualified electrician can approve the wiring in the new office.

senses.en: A plan that shows when activities are meant to happen.
senses.example: The revised schedule gives each department twenty minutes to present its results.
